title: Hatsune Miku — Marks With A Message〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks for letting us borrow the stage today, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're welcome♪
Come back any time you like, okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We really can't thank you enough, Miku.
But I'm not sure when we'll be able to visit next...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Between work and packing, we might not be coming back for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Packing?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, since we have a move-in date for that house now. We're in the middle of packing everything we'll be taking over.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right! The MORE MORE HOUSE is finally becoming a reality!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! We even found some really cute furniture! We can't wait to show you guys!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't wait to see either♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Would it be okay for me to watch you pack?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sure, but...
You're really that interested?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, because I'd like to see what you're going to take over to the MORE MORE HOUSE.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, tomorrow afternoon should work. We've set aside some time then to get everything packed.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How about this? If you see anybody slacking off, Miku, you can give them a stern warning.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay♪
The next day

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We're here, Minori♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Miku! Oh, you brought Luka and KAITO along!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hello. We decided to tag along♪>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <So, how much have you gotten packed?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha. About that... Actually deciding what to take over is turning out to be harder than I thought...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Hmm... What if you started by writing down all the things that each room in the MORE MORE HOUSE is going to need?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <For example, you talked about having plushies in the room where you'll be streaming.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Gimme one second to get my notebook out!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Luka
rows.Line: <Hello♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Welcome...
Oh, Luka, you're here too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. Actually, KAITO was with us as well, but he decided to help Minori pack.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Um, Haruka?
Can I ask what you were thinking about just now? Is something bothering you?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You saw...?
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, Haruka's wondering if she should take the penguin we got for her or a different one?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, because the one you all got for her means so much. It's big and looks very nice, but it's also a private gift. She's a bit torn there.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't tell me this is keeping her from getting anything else packed. No, that wouldn't be like her...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <No worries there. She said she'd get the other essentials packed first since she can always put the plushies in at the end.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is expected. Thank goodness for her decision-making skills.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, this box is all packed...!
I'll give Haruka a call before I start working on my next one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh wow...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She kept up a great pace while talking to us.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Way to go, Airi!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hello?>

rows.Speaker: Miku & Luka
rows.Line: <Uh oh!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Phew... That was close.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, but your reflexes saved the day♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, which box should I take next?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I can't tape this one up yet, so would you mind taking this one?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay... Wait, Shizuku, this box doesn't say what's inside or where it's supposed to go.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
I'm fairly certain it's full of things for our streaming room...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I already moved another box like that to the front door. Does that mean there are two?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Aren't you glad I asked before you taped it shut...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <It's so interesting how everybody packs in different ways.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, I'm having fun just watching.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Oh, Rin and the others should be done practicing soon. Why don't we go invite them to do the rounds with us, starting from Minori again?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We can go back for KAITO too♪>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Then, let's head back to SEKAI temporarily.
Shall we?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay♪>
